ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (dark-pigmented) to high-intensity (white-mottled) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation across the central and basal regions. High-intensity white mottling is concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes, extending approximately 30% of the lobe length towards the median notch along the trailing edge. A distinct high-intensity circular pixel cluster is located approximately 5% above the median notch apex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an estimated aperture of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/15th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations throughout. Sharp, distinct peaks are visible on the lateral margins, particularly on the right lobe where serrations appear more jagged and irregular.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the upper distal margins, tapering to acute points at the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinctive high-contrast white circular spot situated centrally above the notch. Textured, brownish-tan pixel cluster (suggestive of barnacle colonization) protruding from the right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent cluster of raised, irregular textured material (epibionts) is attached to the trailing edge of the far right lobe tip.
